result.summary: Rework 02b: the six items of decisions/0137 Addition 4 are fixed on top of 2f267d1, nothing else. REVIEWER F1: the do block of the rehearsal step 14 is quoted $do$ … $do$ (cause: a String.prototype.replace in my edit script turned $$ into $). SEC F1: appendAudit throws TypeError before the chain lock unless app.role is platform. SEC F2: rate-limit and admin-delay keys use addressKey(ip): IPv4 whole, IPv6 by /64. SEC F3: uat-login opens the secret file with O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW, checks fstat on the descriptor and reads from it. SEC F5: a password change deletes the user's unused reset codes. SEC F4: named residual row in design section 7; section 19 has one line per fix. Each item probed on the copy under <scratch>.

changes.text: step «Every table of B has a row»: `do $do$ … end $do$` in the one psql -c with ON_ERROR_STOP; nothing else in the file changed.

audit-store.js: currentAppRole(q) (select coalesce(current_setting('app.role', true), '')); appendAudit checks it after the entry check and before lockChain, and throws TypeError «audit: the writer runs only under platform settings» otherwise.

rate-limit.js: addressKey(ip) (IPv4 whole, IPv6 expanded and cut to its first four groups `a:b:c:d::/64`, other text as is); countRequest uses it for the setup, login and reset limits (the user limit stays keyed by the session id); auth.js: the admin delay key is mac("delay", addressKey(ip or "unknown")). ip_hmac columns keep the whole address.

after the lstat checks and the win32 refusal: fs.openSync(file, O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW) (ELOOP → «the identity file is a symbolic link»), fstatSync on that descriptor for the regular-file and mode checks, readFileSync of the descriptor, closeSync in finally.
POST /api/auth/password: deleteUnusedResets(req.q, row.id) after deleteOtherSessions, in the same transaction (the statement already existed in auth-store.js; auth-store.js unchanged).
